newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar edges lower but most gains held.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar edges lower but most gains held.

text.p: White sugar futures turned in a lacklustre performance on Tuesday afternoon although light and steady commission house buying was sufficient to keep nearby prices supported, traders said.

One leading house, which has dominated much of the interest on the buy side in recent sessions, was reported to have been active in October and December but both contracts had trouble breaching initial resistance.
"There's good resistance at $331 and $325 in the December and it looks as if it's had its upside move in London for the moment," said one trader.
"There's nothing really to write home about, there's no great volume -- it's just bits and pieces here and there," he said.
Traders said the nature of the commission house buying was such that it was unlikely to be for fund clients, who have recently been happy to increase their long positions in the London market.
At 1605 GMT October was down 60 cents at $329.20 after moving in a tight $1.40 range. December was down 40 cents at $324.50 and volume reached a light 670 lots.
The Paris market was also quiet with just 271 lots posted on the board.
Both October and December were down 50 cents, at $329.50 and $324.50 respectively.
